subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three guard repairs and exact-head checks pass, should OpenClaw accept the credential-bearing and code-scanning action revisions as one grouped update?
rationale: The pins are authentic and the Codex contract remains compatible, but trust in new third-party code executing with secrets and security permissions requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Approve repaired group
options.body: Land after guard synchronization, green exact-head checks, and security-owner review of the upstream deltas.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, registry/build, Codex, and CodeQL revisions for narrower independent trust review.

options.title: Defer the batch
options.body: Postpone the group if its combined privileged dependency review is not tractable.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired group
recommendation.body: Land after guard synchronization, green exact-head checks, and security-owner review of the upstream deltas.

likelyOwner.reason: This team owns the most security-sensitive changed workflows and their focused guard tests.
